title: Smoky Red Lentil and Roasted Pepper Soup
description: Red lentils dissolve into a smoky puree of sweet pepper and cumin.

ingredients.name: peeled unsalted roasted red bell pepper, pureed

steps.title: Prepare the ingredients
steps.text: Rinse {lentil} in a fine sieve until the water runs clear.

steps.title: Set up the pot
steps.text: Use the enamel Dutch oven on a medium burner; adjust the flame to hold a bare simmer.

steps.title: Build the base
steps.text: Warm {butter} over medium-low and bloom {garlic}, {paprika} and {cumin} for 30 seconds.

steps.title: Simmer
steps.text: Stir in {broth}, {roastpep} and the lentils. Cover loosely and simmer 18–23 minutes until the lentils collapse.

steps.title: Finish
steps.text: Blend half the soup until smooth and stir it back in with {lemon}. Add hot water by the spoonful if needed.

notes: Make ahead: chill in shallow containers within 2 hours and refrigerate for up to 3 days. Freezer-Friendly Verdict: Yes, freeze in meal-size containers for up to 2 months. Fridge reheat: stir over medium-low heat to 165°F, adding a splash of water as needed. Freezer reheat: thaw overnight in the fridge, then reheat to 165°F. Option A uses the listed tomato or lemon. For gentler Option B use roasted pepper puree in place of tomato, or omit lemon. Estimated nutrition per serving (1/4 of recipe): 195 kcal, 12.2 g protein, 30.3 g total carbohydrate, 3.6 g fat, 5.2 g fiber, 34 mg sodium.
